phase: 0.2.3 动力网络复验与侧驱拓扑

environment.mode: single-player integrated server, real graphical client, creative site 16x10x16

controlled_verification.prompt: apply creative_motor[facing=up] at (0,-58,0), shaft[axis=y] at (0,-57,0), millstone at (0,-56,0); inspect all three, then read the millstone again
controlled_verification.result: all three blocks read 16 RPM on one network; the second millstone read was 16 again
controlled_verification.conclusion: KineticBlockEntity.initialize() after the batch write makes placed kinetics join a network before the first read; the previous 0 RPM readings are fixed

official_topology_probe.conclusion: a side cogwheel with axis=y meshes the millstone and keeps the bottom free for output; this matches the official Ponder millstone structure

regression_found_and_fixed.problem: the temporary cogwheel auto-orientation pointed the cogwheel at its neighbour face (axis=x when east of the millstone), which broke the axis=y side mesh; the model reported that side gears never drive the millstone
regression_found_and_fixed.fix: auto-orientation now applies to create:shaft only; cogwheel axis is left to the caller

tool_changes: KineticBlockEntity.initialize() + updateSpeed after every batch write
shaft axis inferred from neighbouring cells in the same batch (fill uses the box axis)
millstone warnings: output blocked by a kinetic block below, or bottom free and a chute/barrel should go there

runs.reason: model reported side cogwheels never drive the millstone (caused by the removed auto-orientation) and stopped to ask
after removing cogwheel auto-orientation the model still could not decide the motor output face and transmit rotation; it cleaned up and stopped

stability.pattern: all three crashed in the render thread (net.minecraft.class_310.method_1514 on the stack) at 3m49s, 12m03s and 3m44s; frame 0x00007ffd52bf69e1, no engineering Java frame in the crashing stack
stability.impact: the world is saved before the crash (region file written within ~40 s), so results can be read after a restart; a model turn usually finishes before the crash
stability.note: treated as an environment/graphics issue, not an engineering tool defect; still to be reproduced with a clean client

verdict: power network initialisation and the official side-drive topology are verified in isolation, but no autonomous run has produced a two-stage line yet
